name: Keiko Everlasting
source:
Keitaro, a teenage boy from Kagoshima, Japan with a happy and fruitful life, is forced to leave everything he knows behind and start anew on the other side of the country. Fortunately, he makes new friends...including a girl named Keiko. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/852630/]Steam[/url]]
